item.jaymoskingdoms.wanted_poster.toolti: Illager work. Your own can be torn up; another's can be pinned up where illagers will see it.
item.jaymoskingdoms.raiders_horn.tooltip: They come when it sounds. They do not come back soon if none of them go home.
item.jaymoskingdoms.evoker_notes.tooltip: Close writing in the illager hand, and diagrams of something small and gold.
item.jaymoskingdoms.crude_totem.tooltip: It will hold death off once. Not kindly.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wanted.cleared: The illagers have stopped asking after you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wanted.quiet: No horn answers. They will leave this ground be for a while.
message.jaymoskingdoms.working.lacking: The working wants %s pages over a brewing stand, and an emerald block in your other hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.working.failed: The working comes apart in smoke.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.buy_off: Pay to have your posters taken down (%s)
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.bought_: Done. By morning nobody remembers the face. Do not make us draw it again.
Coin is a good eraser. The posters come down tonight.
Paid. You were never here. Neither was I.
